name: clinica-dwi-connectome
description:
Connectome-based processing of DWI datasets.

See https://aramislab.paris.inria.fr/clinica/docs/public/latest/Pipelines/DWI_Connectome/

inputs.description: Set the desired number of streamlines to generate the tractography and connectome. (Default: 1000000)
inputs.name: n_tracks

inputs.description: TSV file containing a list of subjects with their sessions.
inputs.name: subjects_sessions_tsv

inputs.description: Temporary directory to store pipelines intermediate results.
inputs.name: working_directory

inputs.description: Number of cores used to run in parallel.
inputs.name: n_procs
